headline: Oncoclínicas Reaches 74.6% Creditor Support for Extrajudicial Recovery
summary: Oncoclínicas has secured support from creditors holding over R$ 4.3 billion in debt, representing 74.6% of its total debt base, for its extrajudicial recovery plan.
why: High levels of creditor support in a restructuring process are essential for a company to avoid bankruptcy and stabilize its financial position.

impacts.name: Oncoclínicas
impacts.why: Progress in debt restructuring reduces default risk and improves liquidity outlook.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Advancement in debt restructuring typically eases market concerns regarding the company's solvency.
